name: @classyear/contract-tests
description: Old-vs-new endpoint parity gate — invokes the deployed Lambda handlers and diffs them against the NestJS app
_comment_scripts: Deliberately no `test` script. This suite cannot run bare: it needs a scratch database, a scratch MinIO, and both implementations pointed at them, all of which scripts/run-contract-tests.sh sets up. Naming it `test` would put it in `npm test --workspaces` at the root, where it would fail for want of an environment rather than for want of parity. Run it with `npm run contract:verify`.
